blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran journalist Melinda Quintos de Jesus on Tuesday received the prestigious University of the Philippines (UP) Gawad Plaridel for 2026, an award recognizing her life’s work championing press freedom and democracy. De Jesus was honored mainly for serving as the “conscience of Philippine media” through the Center for Media Freedom and Responsibility […]...
